name: bare hands
description: Nothing in your hands. You hit what you can reach and it hits back — the floor every other weapon in this list is measured against.
notes: T81 · the pre-T80 melee profile EXACTLY (drawInt(1,2), MELEE_NOISE, no pierce, no wear, no modifier). Has no item behind it and is never placed by loot; it is what a broken weapon drops to.
